d:
I noticed this comic wasn't upload on the site, so I decided to post it. This was a series of commissions I paid Asera to draw involving a Barbarian character who gets fucked in unusual ways by different monsters. It's meant to be over the top and wacky, but also fappable.

All credit for character and monster designs belongs to the artist, Asera. Asera also wrote the vast majority of the dialogue.
